name: Expense Check
office_task: Check each staff expense claim has its receipt, a proper tax invoice where the ATO needs one, and fits our expense policy, then queue it for the approver to approve or reject.
systems_of_record: Xero or MYOB (the ledger that issues the bill_id for the claim, entered as a draft bill payable to the staff member, and holds the expense policy lines)
the document store where receipts and written pre-approvals are filed

emits.write: the claim's draft bill marked as passing all four checks and queued for the approver, with each check record (policy cap, units supported, out-of-policy pre-approval, monthly allowance), the tolerances in force and the receipt; the bill stays a draft and nothing is reimbursed
emits.readback: reading the bill_id back from the ledger returns the bill still in draft with the seam fields seam.queue = done_reversible and seam.tolerance_version; a bill that does not read back as a draft means nothing was queued and the run raises an exception

emits.write: an exception record on the claim naming the person who owns it: the check that failed and the checks that never ran, the difference in dollars, the receipt, and its queue (needs a decision, waiting on the staff member for a receipt or tax invoice with a drafted request, or blocked: no policy line, or an out-of-policy item with no written pre-approval)
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the bill_id, the failed check, the dollar difference, the receipt and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
